data.name: Ayushmaan
data.gender_notes: Ayushmaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ayushmaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayush' which means 'life' or 'health'. The suffix 'maan' means 'prosperous' or 'healthy'. Thus, Ayushmaan can be interpreted as 'one who is full of life' or 'one who is prosperous'. This name is popular in Hindu culture and is often given to newborn boys. The name Ayushmaan carries the meaning “Life, Health, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayushmaan usually hope their child will grow to embody life, health, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of good health and longevity.
data.etymology: Ayushmaan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, Health, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayushmaan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ayushmaan carries a deeper meaning. It is believed that a healthy body is a prerequisite for a healthy mind and soul. By bestowing the name Ayushmaan, parents are asking for blessings for their child's physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. It is also believed that the name carries positive vibrations, attracting prosperity and success in all areas of life. In essence, Ayushmaan is a reminder of the connection between physical health and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ayushmaan: The name Ayushmaan signifies a person who is blessed with good health and longevity. The Sanskrit words 'Ayush' (life) and 'Maan' (manifestation or fulfillment) symbolize the belief in the divine granting of long and healthy life to the bearer.
